J.caveat: REPRODUCIBILITY, not correctness: on the first attempt of this phase the failpoints suite deadlocked nondeterministically in the lib unit test fuse_native::tests::worker_pool_drop_joins_workers_with_outstanding_jobs (all threads observed in futex_wait; the container was idle at 0% CPU). The queue's only wakeup, JobQueue::close -> notify_all, does not take the queue mutex, and JobQueue::pop re-checks `closed` immediately before Condvar::wait, so a lost-wakeup window is plausible. The container was removed and the suite re-run cleanly (461/0 in 1.28 s for that test). The hang is not diagnosed to a fix here (out of audit scope); recorded as a nondeterministic-hang caveat, not a gate failure.
